messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: tenant=cedarbrook-prod | dedicated-pool=cdbk-dedicated-2 | metric=p99_latency & 5xx_rate elevated. 18% 5xx over last 5m, p99 ~2.4s. Auto-retries increasing. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-fallback>. Paging oncall.

ian (prod-oncall): acked, I'm on it. Paging SRE and Eng-runtime. Cedarbrook is a paying Enterprise VPC tenant — priority high. @cedarbrook-ops, any visibility on downstream errors?

cedarbrook-ops: yes seeing failures in payment scoring path, errors started ~10:12 UTC. Customers hit ~failed scoring modal; rolling back isn't an option on our side. Please advise mitigation asap.

jess (eng-runtime): looking. Initial hypothesis: model kernel mismatch post-quantized deployment caused occasional OOMs leading to 5xx. Options: 1) pin tenant to last-known-good model version (v2026-02-18) 2) route to safe-variant (compact-q4) on backup pool cdbk-backup-1 3) divert traffic to ephemeral fallback endpoint (higher latency but stable). Recommend immediate pin + gradual route to backup pool.

ian (prod-oncall): prefer minimal customer impact: pin + 10% canary to backup pool, then ramp. Jess, can you run the pin and routing change? Keep KV cache intact if possible to avoid cold prefix penalty.

jess (eng-runtime): on it. Running CLI patch to set tenant pin and a routing override.

jess (eng-runtime): ```
# pin model to stable
rictl tenants pin --tenant cedarbrook-prod --model-id rdx-open-7b --version v2026-02-18
# add routing override to send 10% to cdbk-backup-1 safe-variant compact-q4
rictl routes set --tenant cedarbrook-prod --policy gradual --targets cdbk-dedicated-2:90,cdbk-backup-1:10 --variant compact-q4
```

platform-bot: ACTION: model_pin applied for tenant cedarbrook-prod -> rdx-open-7b@v2026-02-18 by jess. Routing override created: 90/10 to cdbk-dedicated-2/cdbk-backup-1 (variant=compact-q4). See: <https://redwood.internal/tasks/CP-4521>

jess (eng-runtime): verified API health on canary: 10 requests sampled -> 0 errors, p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms. logs: ```
[1775010205] cedarbrook-prod - routed->cdbk-backup-1 compact-q4 - status=200 - lat=420ms
[1775010210] cedarbrook-prod - routed->cdbk-dedicated-2 - status=200 - lat=360ms
```

ian (prod-oncall): good sign. I'm notifying Cedarbrook and ops. @emily please coordinate post-incident comms.

emily (solutions): emailing Cedarbrook support and account team now. Proposed customer note: temporary pin to previous model + safe-variant canary applied, monitoring closely. ETA for full ramp if stable ~20-30m.

cedarbrook-ops: thanks, appreciate the speed. Please flag if any latency spikes during ramp. We can tolerate up to 500ms p95 for scoring.

jess (eng-runtime): will watch. Ramp plan: 10% -> 30% in 10m -> 60% in 20m -> 100% in 40m if error rate <1% and p99 <1s. If errors reappear, immediate rollback command is ready.

ian (prod-oncall): monitoring dashboards show 5xx dropping to 1.2% after canary, p99 down to 0.9s. Keeping oncall for next 45m.

platform-bot: NOTIFY: routing ramp scheduled (10m cadence). Next check at +10m.

jess (eng-runtime): tick - moved to 30% -> samples stable. 

ian (prod-oncall): 30 -> 60 now. p99 steady ~0.95s.

jess (eng-runtime): 100% ramped to pinned model + compact-q4 on backup pool. All traffic shifted by 1775013000. Final checks: no 5xx spikes, p99 ~0.82s.

ian (prod-oncall): closing immediate pager. Leaving remediation and RCA follow-ups: - investigate kernel selection path causing OOMs on cdbk-dedicated-2 - test eviction behavior affecting KV cache for mixed quantized models - add automated pre-deploy compatibility checks for dedicated pools. Assigning to eng-runtime and infra.

emily (solutions): prepping customer-facing summary and next steps: ETA for RCA doc by EOD.

cedarbrook-ops: confirmed systems back to normal on our side. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ian (prod-oncall): handoff: morning SRE oncall (shift change) to pick up RCA after 08:00 UTC. Incident closed from active pager at 1775013600.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: sev=high -> mitigated. Duration ~4,600s. Follow-ups: CP-4521 (routing change), ENG-2872 (kernel mismatch investigation), RCA doc (owner=jess).
